title: Utillian 2 Dual Quartz Replacement Coil
description:
Description
Sold individually. Please adjust the quantity to the desired number prior to ordering.
*Choose colour that matches your device.
This is a replacement Dual Quartz heating element for the
Utillian 2 Wax Pen Concentrate Vape Device
and is identical to the original Dual Quartz heating element received with the Utillian 2. Perfect for replacing your original if it is damaged, dirty or lost.
